stories.title: Designing for people: Human-centered design and OPM’s HR 2.0 modernization initiative
stories.why: Steve Krauss and Sydney Heimbrock explain why OPM needs to pay close attention to how the new platform is configured and continuously refined.

stories.title: US military says there was no white phosphorus leak at its air base in South Korea

stories.title: Military readiness depends on getting Basic Allowance for Housing right
